purpose: Briefs for evaluating an agent that rebuilds a deck on brand with the skill. scripts/recreate-eval.ts grades the folder an agent delivers against the measured gates of each case. These are not records of completed agent runs.

cases.prompt: Make this deck on brand, light and dark, as .lolly and .pptx. Keep every string and every speaker note, or declare each change with its reason in edits.json.

deliver.names: one <name>.lolly for every theme, listed with its themes in delivery.json ({ "files": { "harbour.lolly": ["light", "dark"] } }), and <name>-<theme>.pptx per theme, for example harbour-light.pptx and harbour-dark.pptx; a document per theme may instead be named <name>-<theme>.lolly
deliver.edits: edits.json, optional: a JSON array of { source, result?, reason }, one entry per string changed or dropped on purpose

requires: A repository checkout, so the source deck and the design system resolve
For the .pptx export and the reopen check: a web build that has the #/open route, or LOLLY_WEB_BASE pointing at a dev server run with the same LOLLY_PROFILE
checks: Eight slides in every delivered file, in the source order
Every source string present, or declared in edits.json with a reason
Every speaker note carried, with its line breaks
No check error in any delivered file
Both themes delivered as .lolly and as .pptx
Each .lolly reopens as a saved Design session with its label
The cover photo keeps its proportions, and text over a photograph stays legible
No numbered cards with coloured strips, no eyebrow over a heading, and text set left

cases.prompt: Make this deck on brand, light and dark, as .lolly and .pptx. Keep every string and every speaker note, or declare each change with its reason in edits.json.

deliver.names: one <name>.lolly for every theme, listed with its themes in delivery.json, and <name> <theme>.pptx per theme; any other file's theme is read from its name

requires: The private brand pack and a private source deck, named by LOLLY_RECREATE_SOURCE; neither is in a public clone
checks: The same measured gates as recreate-synthetic, against the private deck and the brand's own design system

measured: Missing source strings and speaker notes, after declared edits
Each .lolly reads back in Node and reopens through #/open
reviewed: Design-system adherence beyond the measured rules
Verify findings and draft house-rule findings, which are reported and never gate
rubric.report: Record the score JSON, the delivered files, the findings that were reported but not gated, the checks that could not run and why, and any scaffolding the agent left in the folder. Passing the measured gates does not establish design quality.
